live_verification.manifest_scope: All 14 event-bearing batch identities are outside the published 567-company landscape; map event arrays correctly remain unchanged while 161 new investor profiles are published.

identity_notes: Astrolight separates mixed investor/ESA support, NATO DIANA awards, a CASSINI prize and the later seed round without treating a blended headline as all-equity.
Astroscale preserves issuer and subsidiary distinctions across venture rounds, grants, the IPO and 2026 convertible/share instruments; contracts were excluded.
Asylon retains the company-announced USD24m Series B over conflicting secondary coverage and records the Leonid term loan separately.
ATMOS keeps the EIC blended award, Match investment and Series A distinct while documenting possible headline overlap.
ATmoto preserves nine dated public financing records but leaves totals undisclosed where Chinese database and investor descriptions conflict.
Atos distinguishes bridge debt, rights cash/debt offsets, creditor equitisation and new-money facilities; amounts are not summed as fresh cash.
AURA AERO separates equity, blended EIC/France 2030 packages and grants, and holds the EUR340m cumulative headline rather than inventing a single round.
Aureus financing excludes predecessor Powerus transactions and the post-merger bridge loan; Auriga SBIR procurement and Aurora's Boeing acquisition were held.
Autel's three amount-undisclosed rounds remain undisclosed; only the secondary-source-supported CNY80m Series A is quantified.
AutoFlight retains CATL's publicly described strategic investment without converting 'hundreds of millions' into an invented exact amount.
